method: Built-in image_gen tool; one distinct transparent asset call per token. Bus used a targeted image-gen background/edge edit after the first draft; only the selected final PNG is copied to the project. No CLI, API key, paid voice/story service, or deployment used.
scope: Original PNGs preserved byte-for-byte; derivative WebPs created by encoding/resizing only. Runtime maps only existing Amari Memory Match Vehicles tokens and preserves board/progression/Askia.
derivativePipeline: Pillow RGBA; proportionally fit within 512x512 with Lanczos; WebP quality 88, alpha_quality 95, method 6.

assets.editPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: isolated picture-card vehicle illustration. Edit only the background and edge treatment of the supplied image: preserve the bus's exact body, windows, wheels, lighting on the bus, viewpoint, proportions, and colors. The final image must have true transparency outside the bus, no colored fringe, no ground plane, no text, no logo, no watermark, no border. Do not change or redraw the bus.
